temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Donald is unhappy or dissatisfied with his job, specifically because it feels repetitive.

temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Donald is dissatisfied with his job and finds it repetitive.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Donald accepts Gloria’s invitation to collaborate on the new project, says he appreciates it, and wants to be more involved.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: The apology was well received, the tension has eased, and Gloria wants to strengthen their professional relationship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Donald is receptive and positively engaged; collaborating may be a good way to rebuild and strengthen their professional relationship.

temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Donald’s positive response confirms that recognition matters to him and reinforces Gloria’s view of him as valuable and engaged.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Donald is a valuable, engaged team member who feels appreciated; public recognition supports his morale and connection to the team.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue recognizing and supporting Donald so he remains engaged and valued.
